description: View dimension of the FCF Canonical System Map: 'how far is the hierarchy currently expanded'. Views are presentation presets rendered as native draw.io custom-action buttons. scopeLens: 'clear' = restore neutral colors, a scope id = apply that lens, 'keep' = do not touch colors. expansion: 'collapse'/'expand' name collapsible nodes; presets use idempotent hide/show sets (never toggle) so they never fight manual expand/collapse state.

views.label: Overall
views.comment: Canonical reset: main chain only, neutral colors.
Applies the 0.3.4.0 scope lens only; never touches expansion state (orthogonality requirement).

views.label: Spatial Bake Detail
views.comment: Expands the Spatial Opportunity subtree only; never touches the scope lens, so it composes with the 0.3.4.0 coloring.
